newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse OKs Avax rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse OKs Avax rights issue.

text.p: The Athens bourse approved the 2.064 billion drachma rights issue of Greek construction firm Avax, it said in a statement.
Avax will issue 1.72 million new common registered shares with a par value of 150 drachmas at 1,200 each.
The terms will be four new shares per 10 outstanding.
Nearly half of the proceeds will be chanelled into the Attiki Odos BOT project, best known as the Stavros-Elefsis ring road, where Avax claims a 6.9 percent.
A third will be used for working capital purposes and to acquire equipment.

Smaller amounts shall be invested in real estate holdings and the BOOT project in Moldova for construction of a port terminal and fuel and LPG storage facilities. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
